title: Copycat Homemade Olipop Recipe by Better Sweet Drinks
description: A fizzy homemade soda inspired by Olipop with ginger, fruit juice and optional inulin.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: 1/2 cup hot water, for steeping ginger
1–2 teaspoons lemon or lime juice, to taste
instructions:
1. Steep ginger in hot water for 5 minutes. Strain and chill.
  2. Combine cold ginger tea, fruit juice and lemon or lime juice. Sweeten to taste.
  3. If using inulin, dissolve it in a little cool water and stir in.
  4. Just before serving, add chilled sparkling water. Stir gently and serve over ice.
notes: Serve freshly mixed for the best fizz. Fiber is optional; larger servings of inulin can cause gas or bloating. Use juice or culinary extracts labeled for food use, not aromatherapy essential oils.
keywords: copycat homemade olipop recipe, chilled drink, drinks for summer, refreshing, fizzy drinks
